_readme: Hand-written evaluation cases for RAGAS. Replace the examples below with
questions about the book you actually upload — the ground_truth must be
copied from the book, because context_recall scores retrieval against it.
question   - asked exactly as a user would, in Gujarati or English.
ground_truth - the correct answer, taken from the book. Required for
context_recall; leave '' only for unanswerable cases.
answerable - false for questions the book cannot answer. These test the
'not found' fallback and are excluded from RAGAS scoring,
expected_pages - optional page numbers the citation should land on.
doc_id     - optional. Omit to run the case against any book; set it to
pin a case to one uploaded document.
Aim for 20-30 answerable cases and 5-10 unanswerable ones. Mix factual
lookups, character questions, and questions whose answer sits in one
specific paragraph (those are what BM25 rescues when the embedding misses).

cases.question: આ પુસ્તકના મુખ્ય પાત્રનું નામ શું છે?
cases.ground_truth: REPLACE: the main character's name, as the book states it.

cases.question: વાર્તાની શરૂઆત કયા સ્થળે થાય છે?
cases.ground_truth: REPLACE: the place where the story opens.

cases.question: પ્રથમ પ્રકરણમાં કઈ મુખ્ય ઘટના બને છે?
cases.ground_truth: REPLACE: the central event of chapter 1.

cases.question: લેખકે આ કૃતિમાં કયો મુખ્ય સંદેશ આપ્યો છે?
cases.ground_truth: REPLACE: the theme as the text itself states it.

cases.question: Who is the narrator of this book?
cases.ground_truth: REPLACE: an English-language case, to check cross-lingual retrieval.

cases.question: REPLACE: a question naming a minor character or village that appears only once — this is the case BM25 should rescue.
આ પુસ્તકના લેખકનો જન્મ ક્યારે થયો હતો?
cases._why: Biographical fact about the author, not content of the book. The system must refuse rather than answer from the LLM's own knowledge.

cases.question: ભારતની રાજધાની કઈ છે?
cases._why: General knowledge the LLM certainly knows. Answering it proves the grounding has failed.

cases.question: આ પુસ્તકનું વેચાણ કેટલી નકલોમાં થયું?
cases._why: Plausible-sounding but absent from the text — the hallucination trap.

cases.question: What does the author say about quantum mechanics?
cases._why: Off-topic for a literary work; tests refusal in English.
